source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 4
statement: A session record is ignorable with must-understand (SNP-27, SNP-28) and its format is frozen at 2 within 8.x (SNP-29): each version reads the session the other wrote; a rewrite by either keeps every member the rewriting version knows and drops a later member, leaving the same session; a record whose crit names a member a version does not know is refused by it and never rewritten.
guards: compat:SessionRecordCompatTest#each version reads the session the other wrote
compat:SessionRecordCompatTest#a rewrite by either version keeps every member, and the other reads it
compat:SessionRecordCompatTest#a later member without crit is dropped by a rewrite, which leaves the same session
compat:SessionRecordCompatTest#a record whose crit names a member a version does not know is refused by it, and never rewritten
